comment:
* An overlay that uses WindowCallbacks to draw the names of all running CUJs to the window * associated with one of the CUJs being tracked. There's no guarantee which window it will * draw to. Traces that use the debug overlay should not be used for performance analysis. *

* To enable the overlay, run the following: adb shell device_config put * interaction_jank_monitor debug_overlay_enabled true *

* CUJ names will be drawn as follows: *

    *
  • Normal text indicates the CUJ is currently running *
  • Grey text indicates the CUJ ended normally and is no longer running *
  • Red text with a strikethrough indicates the CUJ was canceled or ended abnormally *
* @hide

variables.name: mBgColor
variables.comment: Otherwise, two overlays will overlap and be difficult to read.
